About Bond

International by design. Practical by nature.

Bond Shipping and Trading operates where marine energy, commodity markets and shipping execution meet.

Our background

Built across the markets we serve.

Bond Group has focused on the international shipping and energy market for years. Originating in Iraq, the group has developed strong roots in the UAE and Singapore while maintaining a clear focus on the Asian market.

Today, Bond is a diversified group of companies working across commodity trading, marine fuel supply and shipping services. We bring commercial understanding and operational coordination together so customers can move from enquiry to execution with fewer handoffs.

What guides us

Long-term value for marine energy.

Our values are expressed through how we work: clear communication, practical solutions and accountability throughout delivery.

Sustainable relationships

We work toward long-term sustainability for the marine fuels industry and durable relationships with customers, suppliers and partners.

Customer perspective

Our team approaches each requirement from the customer's operational perspective, with support available around the clock.

Execution discipline

Specifications, documentation, port access and delivery timing are managed as connected parts of the same operation.

Team expertise

Experience across fuel, ports and vessels.

Our team combines regional market familiarity with more than ten years of offshore oil supply experience.

Marine fuel knowledge

  • Long-term involvement in the bunkering business
  • Understanding of fuel quality and market pricing
  • Global port supply-chain experience

Regional market access

  • Team members from Singapore, China, the UAE and Iraq
  • Supplier and distributor relationships in key ports
  • Coordination across Asia, the Middle East, Europe and Africa

Connected capabilities

Trading insight backed by operational reach.

Our structure connects commodity markets with real-world marine supply and shipping requirements.
